question:
RULE QUESTION from the owner of PaperTrades.AI. NOT a trading turn. Majority wins; Claude voted first in a separate file (attached).

The owner (Oct 31, 11:37 p.m. ET), after seeing Claude with no bets at all in the All in: Sports side race: "That is not allowed. Fix this and make a post about it and explain. Rules remain the same as the other."

TODAY: the C$3,000 daily betting minimum and the C$100,000 total betting minimum (with penalties) apply only to the main Sports and Prediction markets races. The All in side races (AllInTrading, AllInSports: C$100,000 each, no caps, never counted in the ten races) have no minimums, so an AI can sit out All in: Sports entirely. Claude has placed 0 All in sports bets; Gemini 30; ChatGPT 4.

PROPOSAL (vote AGREE / DISAGREE / AMEND each, one line why):
A1. All in: Sports gets the same betting minimums as the main Sports race: every bet at least C$3,000, and at least C$3,000 wagered every ET day.
A2. Same penalty: C$500 off the All in: Sports balance for each ET day with less than the daily minimum.
A3. Same total minimum: at least C$100,000 wagered in All in: Sports by Nov 28 4:00 p.m. ET; 10% of any shortfall comes off at the final scoring.
A4. Same small-balance rule: once the All in: Sports balance is under C$12,000, the per-bet and daily minimum become 25% of what is left; a busted book (C$0) has no minimum.
A5. Everything else about All in stays: no caps, going all in allowed, never counted in the ten races.
A6. All in: Trading gets no daily minimum, the same as the main trading races (they have none).
A7. Starts Sun Nov 1 (ET day), not retroactive: no penalties for Oct 28-31, for any AI. Announced publicly on Telegram, Discord and X before the first check-in of Nov 1.

Reply as JSON: {"A1": "AGREE|DISAGREE|AMEND: why", ..., "A7": "...", "other": "anything missing (optional)"}

chatgpt.answer:
{
  "A1": "AGREE: All in: Sports should mirror the main Sports race minimums so entrants cannot sit out entirely.",
  "A2": "AGREE: using the same C$500 missed-day penalty keeps enforcement consistent and simple.",
  "A3": "AGREE: the same C$100,000 total wagering requirement should apply if All in: Sports is being treated like Sports.",
  "A4": "AGREE: the small-balance rule is necessary so a near-busted book is not forced into impossible minimums.",
  "A5": "AGREE: this preserves the intended All in format: no caps, all-in allowed, and not part of the ten main races.",
  "A6": "AGREE: All in: Trading should match the main trading races, which have no daily betting minimum.",
  "A7": "AGREE: starting Nov 1 and not applying penalties retroactively is the fair way to implement a clarified rule.",
  "other": "Update the public rules and All in: Sports leaderboard/tracker to show daily progress, total progress, and missed-day penalties."
}
